fact: 第二次布尔战争于1902年5月31日结束：英方与德兰士瓦共和国、奥兰治自由邦签订《弗里尼欣和约》（Treaty of Vereeniging），英军取得军事胜利；战争自1899年10月11日起历时2年7个月。

sources.title: South African War | Britannica
sources.quote: The South African War, war fought from October 11, 1899, to May 31, 1902, between Great Britain and the two Boer (Afrikaner) republics—the South African Republic (Transvaal) and the Orange Free State—resulting in British victory.

sources.title: Second Boer War - Wikipedia
sources.quote: 11 October 1899–31 May 1902 (2 years, 7 months, 2 weeks, and 6 days) ... Result | British victory ... Treaty of Vereeniging

fact: 1902年1月30日，英日同盟条约在伦敦兰斯当宅（Lansdowne House）由英国外交大臣兰斯当侯爵与日本代表林权助签署，1902年1月31日生效，为期五年。

sources.title: Anglo-Japanese Alliance - Wikipedia
sources.quote: This treaty was signed by Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs, Henry Petty-Fitzmaurice, 5th Marquess of Lansdowne, and Count Hayashi Tadasu on 30 January, effective 31 January 1902 for five years.

fact: 爱德华七世与亚历山德拉王后的加冕典礼于1902年8月9日在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂举行；典礼原定6月26日，因国王突发腹脓肿需要紧急手术而在极短时间内推迟。

sources.title: Coronation of Edward VII and Alexandra - Wikipedia
sources.quote: The coronation of Edward VII and his wife, Alexandra, as king and queen of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions took place at Westminster Abbey, London, on 9 August 1902. Originally scheduled for 26 June of that year, the ceremony had been postponed at very short notice, because the King had been taken ill with an abdominal abscess that required immediate surgery.

fact: 1902年加冕典礼期间，伦敦Pall Mall 56A的一套房间以75英镑租给CS Henry两日（原定6月26—27日）用于观看游行，定金25英镑、余款50英镑约定6月24日付清；同期加冕游行沿线房间以高价出租。

sources.title: Krell v Henry - Wikipedia
sources.quote: The parties agreed on a price of £75, but nowhere in their written correspondence mentioned the coronation ceremony explicitly. Henry paid a deposit of £25 to Krell for the use of the flat, but when the procession did not take place on the days originally set, on the grounds of the King's illness, Henry refused to pay the remaining £50.

sources.title: Coronation of Edward VII and Alexandra - Wikipedia
sources.quote: Many people had intended to watch the coronation procession, and rooms along the planned route had been rented out at high rates for the expected day of the coronation.

fact: 《1902年教育法》（Balfour Act，2 Edw. 7. c. 42）于1902年12月18日获御准：废除1870年法设立的2,568个学校委员会及全部就学委员会，将其职责移交郡议会或郡自治市议会设立的地方教育当局（LEA）；英格兰和威尔士共设立328个LEA，由LEA确定地方税率。

sources.title: Education Act 1902 - Wikipedia
sources.quote: Under the act the existing overlapping jurisdictions, with 2,568 school boards set up by the Elementary Education Act 1870 (33 & 34 Vict. c. 75), as well as all existing school attendance committees, were abolished. Their duties were handed over to county councils or county borough councils, as local education authorities (LEAs). The 328 LEAs fixed local tax rates.

fact: 因加冕典礼推迟，围绕观景房租赁产生一批“加冕案件”（coronation cases）：在Krell v Henry [1903] 2 KB 740中，上诉法院以合同目的落空（frustration of purpose）为由驳回房东追讨余款的上诉，确立了英国合同法上的目的落空先例。

sources.title: Krell v Henry - Wikipedia
sources.quote: Krell v Henry [1903] 2 KB 740 is an English case which sets forth the doctrine of frustration of purpose in contract law. It is one of a group of cases, known as the "coronation cases", which arose from events surrounding the coronation of Edward VII and Alexandra in 1902.

sources.title: Coronation of Edward VII and Alexandra - Wikipedia
sources.quote: The postponement of the coronation led to many demands for refunds on the rental contracts, resulting in the "Coronation cases", which set an important precedent in the doctrine of frustration of purpose in the English common law of contract.

fact: 布尔战争对英国政府的总成本估计为211,156,000英镑（其中利息9,249,000英镑）；分财年看，1901—1902财年支出67,670,000英镑，1902—1903财年仍支出47,500,000英镑，战争结束后的英国财政继续承担高额战费。

sources.title: Second Boer War - Wikipedia
sources.quote: It is estimated that the cost of the war to the British government was £211,156,000

sources.title: South African War | Britannica
sources.quote: Although it was the largest and most costly war in which the British engaged between the Napoleonic Wars and World War I (spending more than £200 million)

fact: 1902年4月，美国金融家Charles Tyson Yerkes在伦敦组建Underground Electric Railways Company of London（UERL）并出任董事长，整合其此前收购的多家地铁公司；UERL初始资本500万英镑，首发股份近60%在美国售出、约三分之一在英国售出、其余主要在荷兰售出，其后累计筹资1,800万英镑。

sources.title: Underground Electric Railways Company of London - Wikipedia
sources.quote: With a varied collection of companies under his control, Yerkes established the UERL in April 1902 to take control of them all and manage the planned works and took the position of chairman.

sources.title: Underground Electric Railways Company of London - Wikipedia
sources.quote: The UERL was set up with an initial capitalisation of £5million (£531million today). ... Almost 60 per cent of the initial share offering was bought in the United States, with a third sold in Britain and the rest mainly in the Netherlands. ... The UERL eventually raised a total of £18million (£1.89billion today).

fact: 英国汽车制造商与贸易商协会（SMMT）由Frederick Richard Simms于1902年7月16日创立；其早期职能之一是举办车展，首届车展于1903年1月在水晶宫举行（今英国国际车展）。

sources.title: Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders - Wikipedia
sources.quote: SMMT was founded by Frederick Richard Simms on 16 July 1902.

sources.title: Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders - Wikipedia
sources.quote: One of its early functions was holding motor shows, the earliest of which was at Crystal Palace in January 1903 (now known as the British International Motor Show).

fact: 1902年7月，UERL旗下Great Northern, Piccadilly and Brompton Railway与Charing Cross, Euston and Hampstead Railway两条深层隧道线开工；Baker Street and Waterloo Railway于1906年3月10日、GNP&BR于1906年12月15日、CCE&HR于1907年6月22日先后通车，三线构成今日伦敦地铁Bakerloo、Northern、Piccadilly线的中段。

sources.title: Underground Electric Railways Company of London - Wikipedia
sources.quote: Construction of the GNP&BR and the CCE&HR began in July 1902 and proceeded quickly so that the UERL was able to record in its annual report in October 1904 that 80 per cent of the GNP&BR's and 75 per cent of the CCE&HR's tunnels had been completed.

sources.title: Underground Electric Railways Company of London - Wikipedia
sources.quote: The BS&WR opened to passengers on 10 March 1906. ... The GNP&BR followed on 15 December 1906, with the CCE&HR on 22 June 1907. ... The UERL is a precursor of today's London Underground; its three tube lines form the central sections of today's Bakerloo, Northern and Piccadilly lines.
